title: IDN-InDepthNews — 'The Bomb Wins Again: How the 2026 NPT Review Conference Became a Monument to Nuclear Complacency'
snippet: Comprehensive post-mortem of the 11th NPT RevCon. Addresses NATO nuclear sharing, New START expiry Feb 2026, three consecutive failures (2015/2022/2026). Nuclear-weapon states fought to prevent acknowledging humanitarian consequences of nuclear weapons. Conference president Do Hung Viet announced consensus could not be reached.
